title: 1/6 F-35 JOINT STRIKE FIGHTER IS A LEMON
summary: Pierre Sprey, a designer of the F-16 and A-10, explains why he thinks the F-35 will not hold up on the modern battlefield. It is part one of a series of F-35 critique videos.
why: HN cites it as an insider's critique of the F-35 whenever the program's problems come up.

quote.text: One of the F-16 designers has some great insights on the F-35
